excerpt.zh: 库存报告：我们拥有的物品数量与我们注册表中的预期数量不符。可能原因：内存库损坏。重制我们的注册表并将其移动到更稳定的机器上。
excerpt.en: Inventory Report: the number of goods in our possession does not match the expected amount in our registry. Suspected cause: corrupted Memory Banks. Reconciling our registry and moving it to more stable machines.

texts.zh: 库存报告：我们拥有的物品数量与我们注册表中的预期数量不符。可能原因：内存库损坏。重制我们的注册表并将其移动到更稳定的机器上。
texts.en: Inventory Report: the number of goods in our possession does not match the expected amount in our registry. Suspected cause: corrupted Memory Banks. Reconciling our registry and moving it to more stable machines.

texts.zh: 故障：我们库存的实际资源数量低于登记数量。原因：数学太难了。重计数/计算/检查资源。
texts.en: Problem: number of resources in our stockpile lower than inventory numbers. Cause: math is hard. Recounting / calculating / checking resources.

texts.zh: 点兵点将，注册表项，对不上量！
texts.en: Ena mena mona mite registry pages: empty. White.

texts.zh: 状态报告：得益于生物助手对我们的库存进行了双重检查，我们能够检测并修复由损坏的内存库引起的一些错误计算。结果，很明显我们库存中的总资源高于最初的估计。
texts.en: Status report: thanks to the Bio-Assistants double-checking our inventory, we were able to detect and fix a number of miscalculations caused by corrupted memory banks. As a result, it has become evident that the total resources in our stockpile is higher than originally estimated.

texts.zh: 故障：我们库存中的资源数量与库存中的预期数量不匹配。原因：数学太难了。但是生物助手帮忙做了作业。找到/发现/重新获得丢失的资源。
texts.en: Problem: number of resources in our stockpile does not match the amount expected in inventory. Cause: math is hard. But Bio-Assistants helped with homework. Found / discovered / regained missing resources.

texts.zh:
点兵点将，注册表项，对不上量！
你拍一，我拍一，生物助手发现货物又一批！
texts.en:
Ena mena mona mite registry pages: empty. White.
Eeny, meeny, miny, moe! Bio-Assistants discovered cargo!
